title: SELECTEDMEASUREFORMATSTRING () of a measure with a dynamic format string is that format string, where the item is evaluated

source.quote: A string holding the format string of the measure that is currently in context when the calculation item is evaluated.
source.supports: the format string of [Converted] in each row's context
the dynamic format string picks the currency's format

alternative: If SELECTEDMEASUREFORMATSTRING returned the measure's static FormatString property instead (none here), the rows would be empty text or an error.
derivation: The item is applied to [Converted] in each currency's row; its format string there is that currency's Format.
